text: intra_op_num_threads controls how many threads ONNX Runtime uses inside a single operator such as MatMul.
On a Raspberry Pi 4, using all 4 cores usually gives the lowest latency, but thermal throttling can reduce sustained performance.
Set graph_optimization_level to ORT_ENABLE_EXTENDED to enable fusions such as attention and GELU fusion on CPU.
Dynamic quantization converts weights to INT8 ahead of time and quantizes activations on the fly during inference.
Static quantization needs a calibration dataset; activations with outliers, such as attention scores, can lose accuracy.
To install ONNX Runtime on a Raspberry Pi, run: pip install onnxruntime
You should benchmark with enough iterations (for example 10 to 50) to get stable p95 latency numbers.
Run vcgencmd measure_temp to check the SoC temperature; above about 80 C the Pi starts to throttle.
If latency is too high, try fewer threads: contention with system processes can make 4 threads slower than 3.
QDQ format inserts QuantizeLinear and DequantizeLinear nodes; ONNX Runtime fuses them into QLinear kernels when it can.
The Cortex-A72 supports NEON SIMD instructions, which ONNX Runtime's MLAS library uses for INT8 GEMM.
wav2vec2-base has about 95 million parameters and a convolutional feature encoder followed by 12 transformer layers.
Word error rate is the number of substitutions, deletions and insertions divided by the number of reference words.
Use sudo raspi-config to enable SSH on a fresh Raspberry Pi OS install.
Peak resident memory can be read from resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss, reported in kilobytes on Linux.
ORT_ENABLE_ALL adds layout optimizations, which mainly help on x86 with NCHWc kernels; on ARM the gain is often small.
Benchmark the FP32 model first to get a baseline before comparing quantized variants.
Set inter_op_num_threads to 1 when running a single model sequentially; parallel execution mode rarely helps here.
A heatsink or small fan keeps the Pi 4 below its soft temperature limit during long benchmark runs.
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 is not needed for ONNX Runtime's default CPU provider, which manages its own thread pool.
LibriSpeech test-clean is the standard benchmark for English ASR; models fine-tuned on 960 hours reach about 3 to 6 percent WER.
Avoid quantizing the first convolutional layers of wav2vec2; ConvInteger kernels are limited on CPU.
Python 3.13 wheels for onnxruntime are available for aarch64 Linux on PyPI.
Prefer measuring p95 over mean latency for interactive speech applications, since tail latency affects users most.
When comparing two configurations, keep threads and optimization level the same so the comparison is fair.
Latency on the Pi varies with background load; stop unnecessary services before benchmarking.
INT8 inference can be slower than FP32 on some ARM cores if the quantized kernels are not well optimized.
To view logs from a systemd service, run journalctl -u yourservice --since today.
The agent should finish once additional tuning no longer improves latency by a meaningful margin.
